title: Require fingerprints for new recall questions

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** Story `SEED-073#require-fingerprints-for-new-recall-questions` at `ac92c470126cd55648270bce40fe8ab3134c3a67` promises to keep a due tracker’s waiting question when its fingerprint matches the authored focus and the read timestamp is absent.

In an isolated checkout, I temporarily removed the authored-fingerprint fallback from the return value of `QuestionGenerationBatchPlanningService.hasCurrentWaitingQuestion`. The maintained fixture creates an unanswered MCQ with the note’s real fingerprint and a missing read timestamp. Its assertion `assertThat(candidates(), empty())` in `QuestionGenerationBatchCandidateMemoryTrackersTest.excludesTrackerWhoseLegacyQuestionWithoutReadTimeMatchesTheFocus` passed at baseline. With the fault, the assertion failed at line 156 because tracker `17859` appeared in the candidate list. A separate diagnostic in the scratch planner confirmed a matching waiting prompt `7700` with a missing read timestamp for that same tracker, and confirmed that the fault treated it as having no current waiting question.

The exact command selected one case in all three runs. The fixture and test file hash stayed identical, production source was restored byte-for-byte, tracked status matched the clean baseline, and the restored run passed. The scratch database and checkout were retired. [Fault XML](/tmp/dough-intent-recall-reuse.IADtwo08/fault.xml) · [Baseline XML](/tmp/dough-intent-recall-reuse.IADtwo08/baseline.xml) · [Restored XML](/tmp/dough-intent-recall-reuse.IADtwo08/restored.xml)

```sh
env CURSOR_DEV=true nix develop -c pnpm backend:test_only --tests '*QuestionGenerationBatchCandidateMemoryTrackersTest.excludesTrackerWhoseLegacyQuestionWithoutReadTimeMatchesTheFocus'
```

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing candidate-selection assertion for this path.

- **Test runtime.** The JUnit case took 0.506 s at baseline, 0.530 s with the fault, and 0.393 s after restoration, measured in the test XML. The corresponding Gradle builds, including the prerequisite migration, took 145 s, 194 s, and 77 s, measured in the runner logs.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable because human time was not measured for the check.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable because active work was not measured separately from test runs and waiting.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 625219 ms (measured), from 1795407073000 to 1795407698219 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: Caught at ac92c470126cd55648270bce40fe8ab3134c3a67. Keep the existing assertion. No follow-up.
